annotations.title: Remove the background from a picture

description: Cut the subject out of an existing PICTURE: a transparent PNG of the same picture, nothing re-drawn (generate_image background:'transparent' paints a new one). A flat price per picture; dryRun returns it. Lands in the Library.

dryRun.description: price only: nothing made, nothing charged

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

image.description: the picture: an https / upload_file URL, a Library id (L0…), or a local path on the CLI
